plan_a_advantages: Includes a strength session to build muscular endurance, vital for trail running.
Features a longer endurance run (135 min) to build the aerobic base necessary for faster times.
More varied run durations cater to different recovery needs and training goals.
plan_b_advantages: Simpler and more concise, potentially easier to adhere to.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a more strategic blend of recovery and targeted aerobic work, including a dedicated strength session crucial for trail running's demands. While Plan B focuses heavily on easy runs, it lacks the specific stimulus needed for speed development and neglects crucial muscle strengthening. Plan A’s inclusion of a strength session and varied run lengths (including a longer endurance run) directly addresses the needs of a runner seeking to improve their pace and resilience on trails.
